text:
incident-bot: Paging: Elevated 5xx rate detected for customer 'Emerald Health' on dedicated VPC pool emerald-pool-2 during canary rollout. Canary percentage: 10%. Auto-alert threshold crossed.

maya: I'm on it. seeing spike in 503s from inference nodes behind emerald-prod-12. Confirmed only in dedicated VPC (emerald-pool-2) — not global.

liam: copying. any recent artifact pinned to that pool?

deploy-bot: Canary started by ci-cd at 1739006000. Artifact: emerald-service@v2.4.3-rc (build 20240328-2243). Canary traffic rule: 10% -> emerald-pool-2. Health checks showing increased latencies at ~1200ms and 503 rate ~6%.

maya: thanks. hypothesis: regression in library causing KV cache invalidations under the customer's prefix workload. I want a graceful rewind: divert canary traffic off emerald-pool-2, pin stable artifact v2.3.9 to that pool, and isolate emerald-prod-12 if we see cross-tenant resource pressure.

liam: agreed. steps: 1) reduce canary to 0% or pause rollout 2) pin pool -> artifact v2.3.9 3) if errors persist, cordon emerald-prod-12 from shared routes (tenant isolate) 4) notify Emerald CSM.

maya: doing step 1 now.

ops-echo: `> redwoodctl rollout set-canary --pool emerald-pool-2 --percent 0`

maya: executed: `redwoodctl rollout set-canary --pool emerald-pool-2 --percent 0` — UI shows canary 0%. Deploy-bot health streams now: 503s dropping but still occasional errors.

liam: proceeding to pin back. pin command below: 
```
redwoodctl pool pin-artifact --pool emerald-pool-2 --artifact emerald-service@v2.3.9 --reason "emergency rollback - canary regression"
```

maya: running pin now. I'll also open tenant quarantine ticket if we see queue/backpressure on platform.

csm_omar: I'm drafting message to Emerald Health PM to say we detected a canary regression, we've paused the rollout and are pinning to the previously stable artifact. ETA for full mitigation ~15min. Will send once confirm pin succeeded.

deploy-bot: Pin action accepted (request id pb-87). Background reconcile scheduled.

liam: pin completed and reconciled. `emerald-pool-2` now serving emerald-service@v2.3.9. Monitoring: 503 rate back to baseline (<0.5%). Latency normalizing to ~220ms.

maya: good. I'm still seeing a single tenant (emerald-prod-12) with elevated transient queues. recommending soft-isolate: remove cross-tenant batching and restrict that tenant to dedicated runtime instances while we monitor.

liam: command to isolate tenant (soft):
```
redwoodctl tenant isolate --tenant emerald-prod-12 --mode soft --duration 30m --notes "post-rollout regression mitigation"
```

maya: isolation issued. `tenant-isolate` job id ti-1123 started. Traffic for emerald-prod-12 moved to isolated instances. Observability: no downstream noise in other tenants after move.

csm_omar: sending update to Emerald Health: "We detected an issue in the new canary artifact, paused rollout, pinned back to v2.3.9, and moved your production tenant to isolated instances as a precaution. No data loss; request latency returning to normal. We will follow up with RCA and timeline for safe re-rollout." Will attach screenshots and monitoring graphs.

ops-echo: quick check: `curl -s https://metrics.internal/pool/emerald-pool-2 | jq .errors` -> `{"5xx": 2, "rate": 0.3}`

maya: passing to liam for extended watch and handoff — I need to jump to payment-incident call. liam, take on-call for Emerald for next 40m?

liam: taking it. `@incident-bot oncall-transfer from:maya to:liam`

incident-bot: Oncall transfer acknowledged. Pager duty handoff recorded.

liam: current status summary for handoff: mitigation complete (canary paused, pinned to v2.3.9), tenant emerald-prod-12 soft-isolated, customer notified, monitoring normal. Next actions: keep isolation for 30m, run smoke prompts against isolated instances, start postmortem ticket, schedule cross-team sync with infra and runtime tomorrow if we see further anomalies.

maya: thanks. small checklist for post-handoff: - collect stack traces from nodes that served 503s - capture kernel logs around 1739005800-1739006300 - gather evals for failing prompt patterns (customer provided example).

liam: noted. starting log pull now. `redwoodctl logs fetch --pool emerald-pool-2 --since 1739005000 --filter "5.." > /tmp/emerald-err.log`

ops-echo: log pull queued. size ~6MB.

liam: pulled traces show repeated OOMs in the kv-cache eviction path on nodes with quantization-ladder enabled. tagging runtime-eng. @runtime-team please triage: probable regression in 4th-party kv layer triggered by new model artifact config.

deploy-bot: historical rollout data shows similar small blips when a canary referenced model-quant profile 'q-optim-x' — correlating.

maya: marking this incident as mitigated for customer-facing impact. continuing internal triage for root cause. I'll update the postmortem ticket with timeline.

csm_omar: Emerald Health acknowledged and appreciates the quick mitigation. They've asked to be kept in the loop for the RCA and for any planned re-rollout windows.

liam: leaving final note: incident closed from on-call perspective at 1739010200 — mitigation steps performed, customer notified, isolation scheduled to auto-release at 30m unless extended. Opening internal incident issue: #INC-emerald-1739.

incident-bot: Incident thread archived to #INC-emerald-1739. Remember to attach logs and the smoke prompt set to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
